item.title: Paula Radcliffe: Dubai Marathon ‘one of the best’
item.description: Paula Radcliffe, the legendary British runner, praised the Dubai Marathon as one of the best, highlighting its inclusive nature and festive atmosphere. Celebrating its 25th anniversary, the event features multiple races, including a full marathon, 10 km race, and 4 km fun run, allowing runners of all abilities to participate. Radcliffe emphasized the grandstand finish as a unique feature that enhances the experience for both runners and spectators.
